brief: Follow-up to the outbound-scrub work (SEC-3). In jarvis/v2/diff_review.py, _clean cleans a model-written field (the review summary and each finding's why and file) by running the credential scrub (redact.scrub_text) first and removing invisible characters after. A key split by a zero-width or bidi character (for example 'ghp_AB' + U+200B + 'CD...') slips past the scrub and is then joined back together by the strip. Make the cleaned text safe regardless of invisible characters inside a key (U+200B, U+2060, U+202E, U+FEFF inside each provider key shape). Do not change behaviour for text without invisible characters.
